entities.name: Ladislav Josef Čelakovský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ladislav Josef Čelakovský was a Czech botanist. He was the son of writer František Ladislav Čelakovský, and father to mycologist Ladislav František Čelakovský (1864–1916). He took an evolutionary approach to the study of plants, alternation of generation, flower structure and other aspects.

entities.summary: Ladislav Josef Čelakovský was a Czech botanist. He was the son of writer František Ladislav Čelakovský, and father to mycologist Ladislav František Čelakovský (1864–1916). He took an evolutionary approach to the study of plants, alternation of generation, flower structure and other aspects.
